observations: Reviewed the baseline and candidate face crop and full stage for all three views (twelve images).
Adult supporting-hand view: the closed eyelid folds have cleaner, less mottled edges; the expression and hand-to-cheek relationship remain visually consistent.
Adult head view: the exposed eyelid edges look smoother and more continuous, with the original eye placement and closed expression. The head silhouette, nose, lips, ears and collar appear unchanged.
Infant contrast at 320 px: both eye outlines remain visible. The change is subtle at this size, with the white face, nose contour and hands remaining legible.
limitations: Three matched raw-module views. No full application loader, build or deployment verification.
